translation: (Polygonum-seed 蓼實 is its envoy; it is averse to platycodon 桔梗, fangfeng 防風, and sinomenium 防己.) Original text of the Benjing: Cornus (山茱萸), flavor sour, level. It chiefly treats cold-heat of pathogenic qi below the heart, warms the center, drives out cold-damp impediment, and dispels the three worms.
